scenes.headline: How an agent helped tune its own serving stack
scenes.sub: Z.ai's Infra Agent, dense feedback, and three bugs it found
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tinsel! Z.ai says a GLM-5.3 agent helped build the stack that serves GLM-5.3-Flash. Here's the feedback loop that made it work.

scenes.label: Dense feedback
scenes.text: Put cheap, local, objective checks between the agent's hypothesis and the expensive full run, so most ideas get answered early.
scenes.say: The idea is dense feedback. Between the agent's guess and an expensive full run, put checks that are cheap, local and objective.

steps.say: An engineer sets the goals and reviews. The Infra Agent, running on GLM-5.3, proposes a hypothesis and a code change.
Before any full run, the change meets quick checks. Is it computed correctly? Where does the time go? Which option wins, and when?
Only a change that survives them reaches end-to-end acceptance: the slow, expensive run.

steps.note: an aggregate number says that it regressed, not which layer
steps.say: An end-to-end number says something got worse. A local check says which layer, and what to try next.

scenes.title: What each kind of check caught

items.say: Comparing split and unsplit runs found a matrix product quietly using TF32, with errors growing over long contexts. The fix combines three TF32 passes.
A timeline read showed a DeepEP call spinning while it held Python's lock, so KV transfer had to wait. Releasing it cut the gap below one percent.
A decode kernel cut each 128-wide head into tiles of 32, so four programs recomputed the same gate. Merging them: one point seven one times faster.

scenes.label: end-to-end throughput after 13 days, against its own first successful run
scenes.note: no tokens per second, no named accelerator, no rival engine
scenes.say: After thirteen days, throughput reached three point two two times. The baseline is its own first run, with no absolute number and no named chip.

scenes.text: Build the fast, local, attributable feedback loop before you trust the aggregate number.
scenes.say: So build the fast, local, attributable feedback loop first, and only then trust the aggregate number.

recap: Cheap local checks before every full run
Each kind of check caught a real bug
scenes.say: To recap: cheap checks first, real bugs found, and a gain measured against its own first run.
